newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Feb C/A surplus FIM 0.7 billion -Cen Bank.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Feb C/A surplus FIM 0.7 billion -Cen Bank.

text.p: The Finnish current account surplus increased to 0.7 billion markka in Febraury from a revised 0.3 billion surplus in January (revised from a 0.5 billion markka surplus), the Bank of Finland said on Friday.
It gave the following balance of payments figures (FIM bln):
(* The Bank of Finland said a negative figure marks an increase in reserves).

Finland's net foreign debt was 272.9 billion markka at end-Febrary, up by 2.9 billion on end-January. The state's share of net foreign debt was 193.0 billion markka, up from 189.9 billion, the central bank said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
